ayahs.textEnglish: WHEN THE SKY is split asunder,
obeying its Sustainer, as in truth it must;
and when the earth is leveled,

ayahs.textLatin: Wa alqat mā fīhā wa takhallat.
ayahs.textEnglish: and casts forth whatever is in it, and becomes utterly void,
obeying its Sustainer, as in truth it must -:

ayahs.textArabic: يٰٓاَيُّهَا الْاِنْسَانُ اِنَّكَ كَادِحٌ اِلٰى رَبِّكَ كَدْحًا فَمُلٰقِيْهِۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Yā ayyuhal-insānu innaka kādiḥun ilā rabbika kadḥan fa mulāqīh(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: [then,] O man - thou [that] hast, verily, been toiling towards thy Sustainer in painful toil - then shalt thou meet Him!

ayahs.textLatin: Fa ammā man ūtiya kitābahū biyamīnih(ī).
ayahs.textEnglish: And as for him whose record shall be placed in his right hand,
he will in time be called to account with an easy accounting,
and will [be able to] turn joyfully to those of his own kind.

ayahs.textArabic: وَاَمَّا مَنْ اُوْتِيَ كِتٰبَهٗ وَرَاۤءَ ظَهْرِهٖۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa ammā man ūtiya kitābahū warā'a ẓahrih(ī).
ayahs.textEnglish: But as for him whose record shall be given to him behind his back;
he will in time pray for utter destruction:
but he will enter the blazing flame.
Behold, [in his earthly life] he lived joyfully among people of his own kind
for, behold, he never thought that he would have to return [to God].

ayahs.textArabic: بَلٰىۛ اِنَّ رَبَّهٗ كَانَ بِهٖ بَصِيْرًاۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Balā, inna rabbahū kāna bihī baṣīrā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: Yea indeed! His Sustainer did see all that was in him!
BUT NAY! I call to witness the sunset's [fleeting] afterglow,
and the night, and what it [step by step] unfolds,
and the moon, as it grows to its fullness:
[even thus, O men,] are you bound to move; onward from stage to stage.
What, then, is amiss with them that they will not believe [in a life to come]?

ayahs.textArabic: وَاِذَا قُرِئَ عَلَيْهِمُ الْقُرْاٰنُ لَا يَسْجُدُوْنَ ۗ ۩
ayahs.textEnglish: and [that], when the Qur’an is read unto them, they do not fall down in prostration?
Nay, but they who are bent on denying the truth give the lie [to this divine writ]!
Yet God has full knowledge of what they conceal [in their hearts].
Hence, give them the tiding of grievous suffering [in the life to come] –

ayahs.textArabic: اِلَّا الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ لَهُمْ اَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُوْنٍ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Illal-lażīna āmanū wa ‘amiluṣ-ṣāliḥāti lahum ajrun gairu mamnūn(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: unless it be such [of them] as [repent, and] attain to faith, and do good works: for theirs shall be a reward unending!.
